test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Given below is a statement followed by two possible reasons numbered I and II. Read the statement carefully and decide which of the two explain(s) the event/observation/information given in the statement.

Statement - Global warming is the unusually rapid increase in Earth's average surface temperature over the past century primarily due to the greenhouse gases released by people.

Reasons:

I. Generating electricity and heat by burning fossil fuels causes a large chunk of global emissions

II. Deforestation contributes to global greenhouse gas emissions. It is responsible for approximately 25% of them.

options.text: Neither I nor II is a possible reason.
Only I is a possible reason.
Only II is a possible reason.
Both I and II are possible reasons.

solution:
Given statement:

Global warming is the unusually rapid increase in Earth's average surface temperature over the past century primarily due to the greenhouse gases released by people.

I: Generating electricity and heat by burning fossil fuels causes a large chunk of global emissions.

Burning fossil fuels (such as coal, oil, and natural gas) releases significant amounts of carbon dioxide (CO₂) and other greenhouse gases into the atmosphere.</
